product_family: Full-stack enterprise generative AI platform: WRITER Agent (delegated agentic execution), AI Studio (agent build/deploy/manage platform with Knowledge Graph RAG), and the Palmyra family of proprietary LLMs (including long-context Palmyra X5, and open-weights Palmyra Small/Base on Hugging Face). Sold to marketing, legal, and other enterprise functions at regulated companies.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Writer maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance and undergoes annual examinations that evaluate the controls they have designed and implemented based on the trust services criteria relevant to Security, Availability, and Confidentiality. Writer has completed an annual SOC 2 (Type II) audit (including HIPAA/HITECH).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: WRITER achieves ISO trust triad, setting new standard for security, privacy, and responsible AI in the enterprise... WRITER has achieved ISO/IEC 27001, 27701, and 42001 certifications, making WRITER one of the first model developers to meet this full slate of global standards for privacy, security, and responsible AI.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701 is an extension of ISO 27001 that demonstrates Writer's commitment to upholding stringent privacy practices that align with global regulations, such as GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA, PCI, and Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 42001 is one of the first global standards for responsible and safe AI, certifying that WRITER has adequate governance, risk, and accountability processes in place to develop and deploy AI systems.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Writer has completed an annual SOC 2 (Type II) audit (including HIPAA/HITECH), and maintains certifications for HIPAA... compliance. Guardrails help organizations meet HIPAA (Healthcare) regulatory requirements through features like PII detection.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Writer maintains a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) incorporated by reference into the applicable subscription agreement; for transfers of Personal Data, the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) form part of Writer's DPA, with specific provisions for Swiss data protection requirements.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Writer maintains certifications for HIPAA and PCI compliance. ISO/IEC 27701 aligns with global regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA, PCI, and Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found on writer.com trust or blog content reviewed. Not listed alongside the ISO/SOC 2/HIPAA/PCI slate described in Writer's own trust materials.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR registry entry or certification found on writer.com. Writer's public trust messaging centers on the ISO 27001/27701/42001 + SOC 2 + HIPAA + PCI set; CSA STAR is not mentioned.

privacy.ai_training_note: Writer's help center states plainly: 'We do not train our LLMs with customer data.' This applies across Starter, Team, and Enterprise plans. The one tier-specific nuance: Enterprise customers can optionally 'further train our models with your own best-in-class examples' for custom fine-tuning, an opt-in, customer-initiated feature, not Writer using customer data to train its base/shared models. No contradiction found between this support-article language and the trust center's marketing claims.
privacy.data_region: Primarily United States (San Francisco-headquartered); international transfers to the EU/EEA and Switzerland are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses referenced in Writer's DPA. No explicit customer-selectable EU-only data residency region was confirmed in the pages reviewed; enterprise buyers requiring EU data residency should confirm directly with Writer's sales/legal team.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Writer states it safeguards information with administrative, technical, physical, and organizational security measures. Standard practice for SOC 2/ISO 27001-audited SaaS is TLS in transit and encryption at rest, though Writer does not publish a specific vendor-domain quote naming the cipher or standard used.

security.name: Access control / governance
security.value: Role-based permissions and least-privilege access with organization- and team-level custom roles; audit logs surface usage across an organization; customers can configure organization-wide data controls including an automated data deletion schedule.

security.name: Agent sandboxing
security.value: WRITER Agent operates within a secure, containerized sandbox completely isolated from host infrastructure and other user sessions; all files and data are temporarily stored and permanently destroyed at the end of each session.

security.name: Content guardrails
security.value: Configurable Guardrails scan content for PII (e.g. Social Security numbers, bank account numbers) and financial data to help regulated customers meet HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS requirements at the application layer.

security.name: Third-party audits
security.value: Annual SOC 2 Type II examination (Security, Availability, Confidentiality trust services criteria); ISO/IEC 27001, 27701, and 42001 certification audits.

security.name: Deployment flexibility
security.value: Enterprise customers can self-deploy Palmyra models into their own Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) for organizations requiring maximum control over data and infrastructure; Palmyra Small and Base are also released as open-weight models on Hugging Face.

products.name: WRITER Agent
products.category: Agentic AI assistant / delegated task execution
products.data_scope: Reads company knowledge/context connected via Knowledge Graph and integrations to execute marketing and content tasks end-to-end; sandboxed session storage destroyed after each session
products.notes: Flagship product, positioned as 'not a tool you prompt, an agent you delegate to.' Available from Starter plan up.

products.name: AI Studio
products.category: Agent build/deploy/manage platform for IT and developers
products.data_scope: Full-stack development environment with Graph RAG, Skills, guardrails, roles/permissions, and observability integrations
products.notes: Targeted at enterprise IT teams; integrates with existing identity, security, and observability stack rather than replacing it.

products.name: Palmyra LLMs
products.data_scope: Model family trained on public + licensed data (not customer data); includes long-context Palmyra X5 (1M-token context)
products.notes: Palmyra Small and Base are additionally released as open-weight models on Hugging Face; larger/closed variants can be self-deployed into a customer VPC for Enterprise customers.

compare.pricing_model: Per-seat SaaS subscription for Starter (published list price, e.g. ~$39/user/month monthly, 14-day free trial) and Team tiers (seat-based, list pricing in the mid-$20s/user/month annual); Enterprise is custom-quoted and unlocks advanced security, flexible deployment (VPC self-hosting), and unlimited custom agents.
compare.data_residency: US-primary hosting with SCC-governed EU/Swiss transfers; Enterprise customers can self-deploy Palmyra models into their own VPC for full infrastructure control; no explicit customer-selectable EU-only region confirmed publicly.

flags: HIPAA and PCI DSS are described by Writer as 'certifications' in secondary summaries, but neither is a certification with an accredited certificate body in the way ISO 27001 or SOC 2 are; both should be treated as compliance/attestation posture (SOC 2 report scoped to include HITECH/HIPAA, PCI-aligned controls) rather than a discrete issued certificate. Buyers considering a healthcare or payments use case should request the SOC 2 report and any BAA template directly from Writer to confirm scope.
No public evidence of FedRAMP or CSA STAR was found; this is worth noting for US public-sector or highly regulated buyers.

Data residency: no explicit EU-only or region-pinned hosting option was confirmed from public vendor pages; only SCC-based international transfer language was found. Enterprise buyers with strict data-residency requirements should confirm directly with Writer.
